title: 1962 Topps Civil War News #59 Submarine Attack Vintage Card H.L. Hunley
descriptionText:
1962 Topps Civil War News, card #59 "Submarine Attack." The front shows the Confederate submarine H.L. Hunley torpedoing the USS Housatonic; the back is the newspaper-style story, "Submarine Attacks Northern Ship - Charleston, Va. - Feb. 17, 1864," about the first successful submarine attack in history.

Condition: Very Good to Excellent for its age. Colors are bright and the black border is solid, with light corner and edge wear and normal toning to the back. No creases, tears or writing found. Please review both photos - they are of the actual card you will receive.

Ships in a penny sleeve and top loader.
